I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-random. I said the deadline for the signed order form at Tansley Parcel is 3 April, which replaces the date they posted in #central-team this morning.

They said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else. I didn't edit or follow up on their earlier #central-team post. The brain saves their correction automatically as a channel message, so I didn't write a separate note. A deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel.
